test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'different'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs an adjective to refer to contrasting types of honey. 
 
• Thus, the second blank is best filled by the adjective **different **which means not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality.
 
• This makes option 4 the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - It should come as no surprise that bees know a lot about honey. They aren't only honey producers; (1) they are also consumers, and pretty sophisticated ones at that. Offer a sick bee (2)** different** varieties of honey, for example, and it will choose the one that (3) **best **fights off its infection. Components in honey can help bees live longer, (4) **boost **their tolerance of harsh conditions such as intense cold and increase their (5) **ability **to fight off infections and heal wounds.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The meaning of the other options are as follows - 

 
• **similar - **having a resemblance in appearance, character, or quantity, without being identical.
 
• **singular - **This is a noun and it means a singular word or form.
 
• **parallel - **(of lines, planes, or surfaces) side by side and having the same distance continuously between them.
